entries.value: Grave Hound — a corpse-pale pack hunter that follows the scent of fear and drags isolated prey underground.
Mire Troll — a regenerating swamp brute covered in reeds, leeches, and stolen fishing hooks.
Cinder Drake — a dog-sized wingless dragon that spits burning resin and nests in chimneys.
Glass Spider — a nearly invisible ambush predator whose brittle web cuts like wire.
Bell Wraith — an armored ghost that becomes solid whenever a nearby bell rings.
Lantern Maw — a floating lure of warm light attached to a huge subterranean mouth.
Bone Orchard — a rooted colony of skeletal arms that grabs creatures and plants their bones.
Frost Widow — a white cavern beast that freezes moisture into decoy silhouettes.
Ink Leviathan — a river monster that blinds boats with black mist before striking from below.
Rust Eater — an armored insect that rapidly corrodes metal and swarms the best-equipped target.
Dream Leech — a translucent parasite that leaves sleeping victims awake but without memories.
Thornback Horror — a territorial plant-beast that launches barbed seeds into open wounds.
Mirror Stalker — a thin humanoid able to move only through reflections and polished surfaces.
Ash Giant — a smoldering humanoid that collapses into choking ash when wounded, then reforms.
Moon-Eyed Basilisk — a six-legged reptile whose gaze petrifies only creatures standing in moonlight.
Choir Worm — a tunnel predator that imitates several familiar voices at once.
Oath Devourer — a faceless fiend strengthened whenever someone nearby breaks a promise.
Storm Roc — a colossal bird nesting inside thunderclouds and hunting anything carrying metal.
Cathedral Mimic — an ancient colony-creature disguised as an abandoned place of worship.
Time-Starved Hunter — a flickering predator that steals seconds from its prey to move impossibly fast.
Crown Hydra — each severed head regrows wearing the face and memories of its killer.
Hollow Saint — a radiant undead figure offering miraculous healing that slowly replaces the recipient's will.
Abyssal Grazer — an enormous peaceful-looking shape whose shadow aggressively consumes living creatures.
Red Comet Beast — a crystalline predator that falls from the sky and multiplies when exposed to magic.
